name: red-shirt-bathroom-curvy-selfie

prompt.project_info: Create a high-fidelity smartphone mirror selfie in a bathroom with a cool blue bedroom visible through the door.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with fair skin and voluminous shoulder-length wavy black hair. She wears a fitted red short-sleeve T-shirt, dark-gray fitted athletic shorts, a thin gold bangle, and long white French-tip nails, holding a blue smartphone with an orange camera module and pink pop-it attachment. She makes a playful pout in a relaxed supported stance.
prompt.composition_elements: Mirror selfie from mid-thigh to above head, upper body turned naturally toward the reflection, one hand holding the phone and the other resting on the white doorframe. Include white bathroom vanity, gray bathrobe on a hook, tiled wall, white doorframe, open bedroom with cool blue light and cherry-blossom branch decal, and light tile floor.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright neutral-white bathroom vanity lighting in the foreground contrasted with cool blue ambient bedroom light, soft realistic highlights on hair and fabric, playful casual fit-check atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone mirror-selfie look, slightly high camera angle, mid-thigh portrait framing, realistic fabric folds, skin, hair, phone case and reflection physics, subtle digital grain.
